description: Makes project declarations resolve from the canonical primary checkout, moves budget runtime state out of tracked project files, and states the reviewer-integrator's post-approval closure authority.
delta: Governed SDD now explicitly grants Review <TASK-ID>, after APPROVE, the same C6 through C10 authority as Proceed with, including the single plain push of origin main and cleanup, under the same prohibitions. Project declaration readers use the primary checkout, and budget runtime state is stored in shared Git metadata rather than .meridian/budget.json.
verification: a clean Governed SDD upgrade installs git-workflow v10 and task-worktree-review-procedure v10 with the post-APPROVE Review closure authority
project show and locations read a declaration changed on the primary checkout from a stale linked worktree
budget writes leave the primary checkout clean
python3 scripts/check_repository.py and python3 -m unittest discover -s tests pass
